title: A countably generated Mittag-Leffler module over a henselian local ring has no associated prime of a tensor product meeting the extended maximal ideal
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma controls the associated primes of $N \otimes_R M$ for a countably generated Mittag-Leffler module over a henselian local ring: they never meet the extended maximal ideal (statement lines 4418-4426). The proof splits the module as a direct sum of finite modules using the henselian hypothesis and reduces to the established case of such direct sums. The reduction is the substance, so the claim is H2.
